job.question: How many printed copies of the proposal must be submitted in the San Francisco Employees' Retirement System (SFERS) general investment consultant RFP?
job.expected_facts: Three (3) paper (hard) copies plus one full electronic copy.
job.acceptance: Three hard/paper/printed copies is fully correct. Electronic-copy mention is optional, not a required extra.

reviews.reason: This is a Boston Retirement System RFP for actuarial and consulting services, not the SFERS general investment consultant RFP. Its printed-copy requirement therefore does not support the question.
quotes: Request for Proposal Actuarial and Consulting Services for Pension Benefits Boston Retirement System September 12, 2022
Please submit one (1) original and five (5) copies of the Proposal to: Ellen McCarthy Boston Retirement System
